request.description:
### 🔄 Instant Token Renewal (Refresh Access Token)

#### 📋 Overview
Exchanges an active **Refresh Token** for a fresh **Access Token** (valid for 15 minutes) and a newly rotated **Refresh Token** (valid for 7 days). This endpoint eliminates the need to repeatedly request and verify 6-digit SMS OTPs whenever customer sessions expire during Postman testing or in the mobile application.

---

#### 🌐 Endpoint Details
- **HTTP Method**: `POST` *(also supports `GET` with query parameter)*
- **Primary URL**: `{{baseUrl}}/api/v1/mobile/auth/refresh`
- **Resilient Aliases**:
  - `{{baseUrl}}/api/v1/auth/refresh`
  - `{{baseUrl}}/api/v1/mobile/refresh`
  - `{{baseUrl}}/api/v1/mobile/auth/token/refresh`
  - `{{baseUrl}}/api/v1/mobile/auth/refersh` *(automatic typo fallback)*
- **Authentication**: None *(Public endpoint – no Bearer token required)*

---

#### 📥 Request Headers
| Header | Value | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Content-Type` | `application/json` | Yes | Request payload format |
| `Accept` | `application/json` | Yes | Expected response format |

---

#### 📦 Request Body Schema (`application/json`)
| Field | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `refreshToken` | `string` | Yes | The rotating JWT refresh token issued by OTP Verify or previous Refresh call | `{{refreshToken}}` |

**Alternative passing methods**:
1. Query parameter: `?refreshToken={{refreshToken}}`
2. Custom header: `X-Refresh-Token: {{refreshToken}}`
3. Authorization header: `Bearer {{refreshToken}}`

---

#### 📤 Success Response (200 OK)
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Token refreshed successfully",
  "data": {
    "accessToken": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzM4NCJ9...",
    "tokenType": "Bearer",
    "expiresIn": 900,
    "refreshToken": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzM4NCJ9...",
    "user": {
      "id": "147ff421-7f6c-4995-98c2-b6de2a9f8eab",
      "name": "Test Customer",
      "email": "testcustomer@pinak.app",
      "phone": "+919876543210",
      "role": "CUSTOMER",
      "status": "ACTIVE",
      "emailVerified": false,
      "phoneVerified": true
    }
  },
  "requestId": "0708aef0-597b-4874-8c4a-e8896bebaf75"
}
```

---

#### ⚡ Automated Postman Best Practices Implemented:
1. **Pre-request Script**:
   - Inspects `{{refreshToken}}` in Postman collection/environment variables.
   - If missing, prints clear instructions to the Postman Console on which request to run first.
2. **Test Script Automation**:
   - Asserts HTTP `200 OK` status.
   - Asserts response time < `1500ms`.
   - Validates JSON response structure according to enterprise schema contract.
   - Automatically stores the fresh `accessToken` into `pm.collectionVariables`.
   - Automatically stores the new rotated `refreshToken` into `pm.collectionVariables`.
   - Downstream authenticated requests (Screen 10 Home, Screen 11 Service Detail) immediately use the renewed token without manual copy-pasting.

---

#### ⚠️ Error Responses
| Status Code | Error Code | Cause | Solution |
|---|---|---|---|
| `401 Unauthorized` | `REFRESH_TOKEN_INVALID` | Token expired, revoked, or manipulated | Run `3. Verify OTP` or `7. Complete Setup` to generate a fresh pair |
| `400 Bad Request` | `VALIDATION_FAILED` | `refreshToken` missing or empty | Provide a valid refresh token string in body |
| `429 Too Many Requests` | `RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` | Rapid brute-force refresh attempts | Wait 60 seconds before retrying |

request.description:
### 🍽️ Screen 11: Store & Service Detail View (The Smokehouse Grill)

#### 📋 Overview
Returns the comprehensive, rich payload for **Screen 11 (Store / Service Detail View)** matching the design specification in `code.html`.
When a customer clicks on any merchant card or service offer in the PINAK mobile discovery rail, this endpoint powers the full screen experience.

---

#### 🌐 Endpoint Details
- **HTTP Method**: `GET`
- **Primary URL**: `{{baseUrl}}/api/v1/mobile/stores/{{smokehouseStoreId}}/detail?lat=12.9716&lng=77.6412`
- **Fallback URL**: `{{baseUrl}}/api/v1/mobile/stores/detail?lat=12.9716&lng=77.6412` *(auto-defaults to The Smokehouse Grill even if storeId is missing!)*
- **Authentication**: `Bearer Token` (`{{accessToken}}`) *(Optional/Permitted: also renders public preview)*

---

#### 🔍 Query & Path Parameters
| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `storeId` | `UUID` (Path) | Optional | `e1000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001` | Outlet UUID (The Smokehouse Grill Mock) |
| `lat` | `Double` (Query) | Optional | `12.9716` | User GPS Latitude for precise distance calculation |
| `lng` | `Double` (Query) | Optional | `77.6412` | User GPS Longitude for precise distance calculation |

---

#### 🎨 Screen 11 UI Components Powered by this Payload:
1. **Hero Media Gallery**: 19 curated photos with real-time `photoCounterText` ("1/19").
2. **Metadata & Status**: `isOpenNow: true`, `openStatusText: "Open till 00:30"`, rating 4.8 (1.2K ratings), `₹1700 for two • Moderate`.
3. **2X Boost Cashback Banner**: `coinsPerkBanner` featuring `badgeText: "2X BOOST"` ("Earn 5.00% PINAK Cashback Coins").
4. **Sticky Sub-Header Navigation Tabs**: `["Offers", "Menu", "Photos", "Amenities", "Location"]`
5. **Active Offers Section**:
   - Primary Hero Deal: Flat 50% Off Pre-Booking & Dining (`PINAK EXCLUSIVE`, `Instant Confirm`, `Special Deal`).
   - Secondary Walk-in Deal: Flat 20% Off Walk-In Dine-in (`WALK_IN_PAY`).
6. **Menu Highlights & Scans**: 4 signature dishes (Truffle Mushroom Risotto, Smoked BBQ Pork Ribs, etc.) + 7 high-res menu scan image URLs.
7. **Photo Mosaic Grid**: 3-photo mosaic with `+16 Photos` modal trigger.
8. **Verified Amenities Rail**: Full Bar, Valet Parking, Table Reservation, PINAK UPI Instant Pay, AC, Free Wi-Fi.
9. **Location & GPS Section**: Complete address, distance (`4.6 km • Indiranagar`), and Google Maps deep-link.
10. **Concierge Desk**: 1-tap call reservation assistance.
11. **Similar Places Rail**: Tipsy Turk Rooftop & Bellavista Skybar.
12. **Sticky Bottom Action Bar**: "Pay Bill Now" (with `50% OFF` badge) and "Book a Table".
